submission.justification: Material F2 with 4 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.053% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. While the fine-tuned optimization suggested 5 mm (3.184%), the initial scan at 4 mm showed superior performance (3.053%). This represents approximately 22% better resolution than the best F1 configuration (3.905% at 6mm) and 40% better than F3 (5.039% at 6mm). The material satisfies the hard constraint on residual dose rate, and the 4 mm thickness falls comfortably within the 2-10 mm range specified in the requirements.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 at 4mm achieves 3.053% resolution, the best among all materials and thicknesses tested (F1 best: 3.905% at 6mm, F3 best: 5.039% at 6mm)

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is one of the three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3) evaluated

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 µSv/h
requirements.evidence: F2_passes_dose_constraint = 1, confirming compliance with the 20 µSv/h limit
Recommended thickness of 4 mm is within the specified range of 2-10 mm
